# Otto Flags SDKs - Complete Documentation

> Otto Flags is an AI-powered feature flag platform that prevents production incidents. This repository contains official SDKs for TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Vue, Svelte, Next.js, Node.js, Go, Java, Rust, iOS, and Android.

---

## Overview

Otto Flags enables safe feature rollouts by:
- **Feature Flags**: Boolean toggles that control feature visibility with targeting rules
- **AI Error Detection**: Automatically correlates production errors with recent flag changes
- **Real-time Updates**: Server-Sent Events push flag changes instantly to all clients
- **Telemetry**: Automatic tracking of flag evaluations for analytics and debugging

### Key Benefits
- Prevent production incidents by quickly disabling problematic features
- Gradual rollouts with percentage-based targeting
- User segmentation by attributes, geography, and language
- Real-time flag updates without page reloads

---

## Installation

### TypeScript/JavaScript (npm)
```bash
npm install @otto-flags/sdk
# or
pnpm add @otto-flags/sdk
# or
yarn add @otto-flags/sdk
```

### React
```bash
npm install @otto-flags/react
```

### Vue 3
```bash
npm install @otto-flags/vue
```

### Next.js
```bash
npm install @otto-flags/nextjs
```

### Node.js Server
```bash
npm install @otto-flags/node-server
```

### Go
```bash
go get github.com/savvagent/otto-flags-go-server-sdk
```

### Java (Maven)
```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>com.savvagent.ottoflags</groupId>
  <artifactId>otto-flags-java-server-sdk</artifactId>
  <version>0.1.0</version>
</dependency>
```

### Rust
```toml
[dependencies]
ottoFlags = "0.1.0"
```

### iOS (Swift Package Manager)
```swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/savvagent/otto-flags-ios-sdk.git", from: "0.1.0")
```

### Android (Gradle)
```kotlin
implementation("com.savvagent.ottoflags:otto-flags-android-sdk:0.1.0")
```

## Quick Start

### TypeScript/JavaScript

```typescript
import { FlagClient } from '@otto-flags/sdk';

// Initialize the client
const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: 'sdk_your_api_key_here',
  baseUrl: 'https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev',
  enableRealtime: true,
  enableTelemetry: true,
});

// Check if a flag is enabled
const isEnabled = await client.isEnabled('new-feature', {
  userId: 'user-123',
  attributes: {
    plan: 'pro',
    country: 'US',
  },
});

if (isEnabled) {
  // Show new feature
} else {
  // Show old feature
}

// Execute code conditionally with automatic error tracking
await client.withFlag('experimental', async () => {
  // This code only runs if flag is enabled
  // Errors are automatically tracked with flag context
  await experimentalFeature();
});

// Get detailed evaluation result
const result = await client.evaluate('my-feature', { userId: 'user-123' });
// Returns: { key, value, reason, metadata }

// Subscribe to real-time flag updates
const unsubscribe = client.subscribe('my-feature', () => {
  console.log('Flag was updated!');
});

// Clean up
client.close();
```

### React

```tsx
import { OttoFlagsProvider, useFlag } from '@otto-flags/react';

// 1. Wrap your app with the provider
function App() {
  return (
    <OttoFlagsProvider
      config={{
        apiKey: 'sdk_your_api_key_here',
        enableRealtime: true,
      }}
    >
      <YourApp />
    </OttoFlagsProvider>
  );
}

// 2. Use the useFlag hook in components
function MyFeature() {
  const { value: isEnabled, loading } = useFlag('new-checkout-flow', {
    defaultValue: false,
    context: {
      user_id: currentUser.id,
      attributes: { plan: currentUser.plan },
    },
  });

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;
  return isEnabled ? <NewCheckout /> : <OldCheckout />;
}

// 3. Track errors with flag context
function ExperimentalFeature() {
  const trackError = useTrackError('experimental-feature');

  const handleAction = async () => {
    try {
      await riskyOperation();
    } catch (error) {
      trackError(error); // Correlated with flag state
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return <button onClick={handleAction}>Try It</button>;
}
```

### Vue 3

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useFlag, useOttoFlags } from '@otto-flags/vue';

const { value: isEnabled, loading } = useFlag('new-feature', {
  defaultValue: false,
});
</script>

<template>
  <div v-if="loading">Loading...</div>
  <NewFeature v-else-if="isEnabled" />
  <OldFeature v-else />
</template>
```

### Next.js (App Router)

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx - Server-side initialization
import { OttoFlagsProvider } from '@otto-flags/nextjs/server';

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html>
      <body>
        <OttoFlagsProvider
          config={{
            apiKey: process.env.OTTO_FLAGS_SDK_KEY!,
          }}
        >
          {children}
        </OttoFlagsProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

// components/Feature.tsx - Client component
'use client';
import { useFlag } from '@otto-flags/nextjs/client';

export function Feature() {
  const { value } = useFlag('new-feature');
  return value ? <NewUI /> : <OldUI />;
}
```

### Node.js Server (Express)

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { FlagClient } from '@otto-flags/node-server';

const app = express();
const flags = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: process.env.OTTO_FLAGS_SDK_KEY!,
  cache: { enabled: true, ttl: 60000 },
});

app.get('/api/feature', async (req, res) => {
  const isEnabled = await flags.isEnabled('api-feature', {
    userId: req.user.id,
    attributes: { plan: req.user.plan },
  });

  if (isEnabled) {
    res.json({ data: 'new response' });
  } else {
    res.json({ data: 'old response' });
  }
});
```

### Go

```go
package main

import (
    "context"
    ottoFlags "github.com/savvagent/otto-flags-go-server-sdk"
)

func main() {
    client, err := ottoFlags.NewClient(ottoFlags.Config{
        APIKey:  "sdk_your_api_key",
        BaseURL: "https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev",
    })
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    defer client.Close()

    ctx := context.Background()
    isEnabled, err := client.IsEnabled(ctx, "new-feature", ottoFlags.Context{
        UserID: "user-123",
        Attributes: map[string]interface{}{
            "plan": "pro",
        },
    })

    if isEnabled {
        // New feature logic
    }
}
```

### Java

```java
import com.savvagent.ottoflags.sdk.FlagClient;
import com.savvagent.ottoflags.sdk.FlagContext;

public class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FlagClient client = FlagClient.builder()
            .apiKey("sdk_your_api_key")
            .baseUrl("https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev")
            .build();

        FlagContext context = FlagContext.builder()
            .userId("user-123")
            .attribute("plan", "pro")
            .build();

        boolean isEnabled = client.isEnabled("new-feature", context);

        if (isEnabled) {
            // New feature logic
        }

        client.close();
    }
}
```

### Rust

```rust
use ottoFlags::{FlagClient, FlagContext};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let client = FlagClient::new(
        "sdk_your_api_key",
        "https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev",
    )?;

    let context = FlagContext::new()
        .user_id("user-123")
        .attribute("plan", "pro");

    let is_enabled = client.is_enabled("new-feature", &context).await?;

    if is_enabled {
        // New feature logic
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

### iOS (Swift)

```swift
import OttoFlagsSDK

// Initialize
let client = try FlagClient(
    apiKey: "sdk_your_api_key",
    baseURL: "https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev"
)

// Check flag
let isEnabled = try await client.isEnabled("new-feature", context: [
    "userId": "user-123",
    "attributes": ["plan": "pro"]
])

// SwiftUI integration
struct FeatureView: View {
    @State private var isEnabled = false

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if isEnabled {
                NewFeatureView()
            } else {
                OldFeatureView()
            }
        }
        .task {
            isEnabled = try? await FlagClient.shared.isEnabled("new-feature")
        }
    }
}
```

### Android (Kotlin)

```kotlin
import com.savvagent.ottoflags.sdk.FlagClient
import com.savvagent.ottoflags.sdk.FlagContext

// Initialize
val client = FlagClient(
    apiKey = "sdk_your_api_key",
    baseUrl = "https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev"
)

// Check flag
val context = FlagContext(
    userId = "user-123",
    attributes = mapOf("plan" to "pro")
)
val isEnabled = client.isEnabled("new-feature", context)

// Jetpack Compose integration
@Composable
fun FeatureScreen() {
    val isEnabled by remember {
        mutableStateOf(false)
    }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        isEnabled = FlagClient.isEnabled("new-feature")
    }

    if (isEnabled) {
        NewFeature()
    } else {
        OldFeature()
    }
}
```

---

## Configuration Reference

### FlagClient Configuration

```typescript
interface FlagClientConfig {
  // Required
  apiKey: string;              // SDK key (starts with sdk_)

  // Optional - API
  baseUrl?: string;            // API URL (default: https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev)
  timeout?: number;            // Request timeout in ms (default: 5000)

  // Optional - Caching
  cache?: {
    enabled: boolean;          // Enable caching (default: true)
    ttl: number;               // Cache TTL in ms (default: 60000)
  };

  // Optional - Real-time
  enableRealtime?: boolean;    // SSE updates (default: true)

  // Optional - Telemetry
  enableTelemetry?: boolean;   // Track evaluations (default: true)

  // Optional - Defaults
  defaults?: Record<string, boolean>;  // Fallback values per flag

  // Optional - Error handling
  onError?: (error: Error) => void;    // Custom error handler
}
```

### Evaluation Context

```typescript
interface EvaluationContext {
  userId?: string;             // User identifier for targeting
  anonymousId?: string;        // Anonymous user ID (auto-generated if not set)
  attributes?: {               // Custom attributes for targeting rules
    [key: string]: string | number | boolean;
  };
  language?: string;           // Language code (e.g., 'en-US')
  environment?: string;        // Environment override
}
```

---

## API Reference

### FlagClient Methods

| Method | Description | Returns |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `isEnabled(flagKey, context?)` | Check if flag is enabled | `Promise<boolean>` |
| `evaluate(flagKey, context?)` | Get detailed evaluation result | `Promise<EvaluationResult>` |
| `withFlag(flagKey, callback, context?)` | Execute callback if flag enabled, tracks errors | `Promise<T \| null>` |
| `trackError(flagKey, error, context?)` | Manually track error with flag context | `void` |
| `subscribe(flagKey, callback)` | Subscribe to real-time flag updates | `() => void` (unsubscribe) |
| `getCachedFlags()` | Get all cached flag keys | `string[]` |
| `clearCache()` | Force re-evaluation on next call | `void` |
| `isRealtimeConnected()` | Check SSE connection status | `boolean` |
| `close()` | Cleanup resources and connections | `void` |

### EvaluationResult

```typescript
interface EvaluationResult {
  key: string;                 // Flag key
  value: boolean;              // Evaluated value
  reason: 'evaluated' | 'cached' | 'default' | 'error';
  metadata?: {
    flagId: string;
    description?: string;
    variation?: string;        // For multi-variant flags
  };
}
```

### React Hooks

| Hook | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `useFlag(flagKey, options?)` | Evaluate flag with loading/error states |
| `useOttoFlags()` | Access underlying FlagClient instance |
| `useWithFlag(flagKey, callback)` | Execute callback when flag is enabled |
| `useUser()` | Manage user identification |
| `useTrackError(flagKey)` | Get error tracking function for a flag |

---

## Targeting & Rollouts

### Percentage Rollouts (Sticky)

Otto Flags uses consistent hashing to ensure users always see the same flag state:

```typescript
// 25% rollout - same users always in the 25%
const isEnabled = await client.isEnabled('gradual-rollout', {
  userId: 'user-123', // Required for sticky behavior
});
```

### User Attribute Targeting

Target users based on custom attributes:

```typescript
const isEnabled = await client.isEnabled('premium-feature', {
  userId: 'user-123',
  attributes: {
    plan: 'enterprise',        // Target enterprise users
    country: 'US',             // Target US users
    signupDate: '2024-01-15',  // Target users by signup date
  },
});
```

### Language Targeting

Target users by language/locale:

```typescript
const isEnabled = await client.isEnabled('localized-feature', {
  language: 'en-US', // or 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', etc.
});
```

### Geolocation Targeting

Target users by country, city, or timezone (requires server-side context):

```typescript
// Server-side with geolocation context
const isEnabled = await client.isEnabled('regional-feature', {
  userId: 'user-123',
  attributes: {
    country: 'US',
    city: 'San Francisco',
    timezone: 'America/Los_Angeles',
  },
});
```

---

## Real-time Updates

### Enabling Real-time

```typescript
const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: 'sdk_...',
  enableRealtime: true, // Default: true
});
```

### Subscribing to Changes

```typescript
// Subscribe to specific flag
const unsubscribe = client.subscribe('feature-x', () => {
  console.log('Flag changed! Re-evaluating...');
  refreshUI();
});

// Subscribe to all flag changes
client.subscribe('*', () => {
  console.log('Some flag changed');
});

// Unsubscribe when done
unsubscribe();
```

### React Real-time

```tsx
// Automatic with useFlag
const { value } = useFlag('feature', { realtime: true });
// Component re-renders when flag changes
```

---

## Error Tracking

Otto Flags's AI correlates errors with flag changes to identify problematic rollouts:

### Automatic Tracking (withFlag)

```typescript
// Errors in callback are automatically tracked
await client.withFlag('new-payment-flow', async () => {
  await processPayment(); // If this throws, error is tracked
});
```

### Manual Tracking

```typescript
try {
  await riskyOperation();
} catch (error) {
  client.trackError('feature-flag-key', error, {
    userId: 'user-123',
  });
  throw error;
}
```

### React Error Tracking

```tsx
function Feature() {
  const trackError = useTrackError('new-feature');

  const handleClick = async () => {
    try {
      await doSomething();
    } catch (error) {
      trackError(error);
    }
  };

  return <button onClick={handleClick}>Do Something</button>;
}
```

---

## Client-Side Overrides

Override flag values locally for development and testing:

### Configuration Overrides

```typescript
const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: 'sdk_...',
  overrides: {
    'new-checkout': true,    // Always enabled locally
    'beta-feature': false,   // Always disabled locally
  },
});
```

### Runtime Overrides

```typescript
// Set override
client.setOverride('feature-x', true);

// Check (returns overridden value)
await client.isEnabled('feature-x'); // → true

// Clear override
client.clearOverride('feature-x');

// Clear all overrides
client.clearAllOverrides();
```

### URL Query Parameters

```typescript
const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: 'sdk_...',
  enableQueryOverrides: true,
});

// Now visit: https://app.example.com?flag:dark-mode=true
// Flag will be overridden based on URL
```

---

## Best Practices

### 1. Initialize Once, Reuse Everywhere

```typescript
// lib/flags.ts
export const flagClient = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: process.env.OTTO_FLAGS_SDK_KEY!,
});

// other files
import { flagClient } from '@/lib/flags';
```

### 2. Always Provide Context for Targeting

```typescript
// Include userId for sticky rollouts
const isEnabled = await client.isEnabled('feature', {
  userId: user.id,
  attributes: { plan: user.plan },
});
```

### 3. Use Default Values

```typescript
const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: 'sdk_...',
  defaults: {
    'critical-feature': true,  // Safe default for critical features
    'experimental': false,     // Safe default for experiments
  },
});
```

### 4. Handle Loading States (React)

```tsx
function Feature() {
  const { value, loading } = useFlag('feature', { defaultValue: false });

  if (loading) return <Skeleton />;
  return value ? <NewFeature /> : <OldFeature />;
}
```

### 5. Enable Telemetry for Analytics

```typescript
const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: 'sdk_...',
  enableTelemetry: true, // Default, but be explicit
});
```

### 6. Clean Up on Shutdown

```typescript
// In cleanup/shutdown handler
client.close();
```

## Environment Configuration

### Development

```typescript
const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: 'sdk_dev_...',
  baseUrl: 'http://localhost:8080',
  cache: { enabled: false }, // Disable for testing
});
```

### Production

```typescript
const client = new FlagClient({
  apiKey: process.env.OTTO_FLAGS_SDK_KEY!,
  baseUrl: 'https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev',
  cache: { enabled: true, ttl: 60000 },
  enableTelemetry: true,
});
```

### Environment Variables

```bash
# .env
OTTO_FLAGS_SDK_KEY=sdk_prod_xxx
OTTO_FLAGS_API_URL=https://flags-api.otto-flags.dev

# .env.local (client-side)
NEXT_PUBLIC_OTTO_FLAGS_SDK_KEY=sdk_prod_xxx
VITE_OTTO_FLAGS_SDK_KEY=sdk_prod_xxx
```

---

## Troubleshooting

### Flags Always Return False
- Verify API key is correct and starts with `sdk_`
- Check baseUrl points to correct API
- Verify flag exists and is enabled for the environment
- Check network requests in browser DevTools

### Real-time Updates Not Working
- Ensure `enableRealtime: true` (default)
- Check if EventSource/SSE is supported in environment
- Verify SSE endpoint is accessible (not blocked by proxy)

### High Latency
- Enable caching: `cache: { enabled: true, ttl: 60000 }`
- Use real-time updates instead of polling
- Batch multiple flag checks

### Inconsistent Flag Values
- Ensure userId is provided for sticky rollouts
- Same userId should always get same value
- Check if flag has percentage rollout configured
